projectDescription: A command-centric, discoverable Ruby framework that encapsulates domain operations in commands with machine-readable metadata, abstracting away integration code for HTTP, CLI, MCP, and more.
keyFeatures: Command-centric architecture: domain operations encapsulated as first-class Command objects
Discoverability: machine-readable manifests for all commands, types, and errors
Command connectors: expose any command over HTTP (Rack/Rails), CLI, MCP, async (Resque), or scheduled jobs with zero glue code
Remote commands: import commands from other services and call them with the same interface as local commands
Domain mappers: translate concepts between domains to keep command logic clean
Rich type system: built-in types (integer, string, boolean, date, datetime, model, entity, array, etc.) with composable validators and transformers
Entities with CRUD drivers: persist domain models using swappable backends (InMemory, LocalFiles, Redis, custom)
Organizations and Domains: hierarchical namespaces enforcing unidirectional dependency graphs
Code generators via the foob CLI: scaffold Ruby projects, TypeScript React frontends, remote command imports, and UI forms
Monorepo with sub-projects: command, typesystem, entities, manifest, domain_mapper, command_connectors
publicApiSurface: Foobara::Command — base class for all commands (.run, .run!, #run, #run!, #execute, inputs DSL, result DSL, depends_on, possible_error, possible_input_error, run_subcommand!, run_mapped_subcommand!)
Foobara::Model — base class for value objects with attributes DSL
Foobara::Entity — base class for persistent domain objects with primary_key, CRUD driver support
Module#foobara_domain! — declares a Ruby module as a Foobara Domain
Module#foobara_organization! — declares a Ruby module as a Foobara Organization
Module#foobara_register_type — registers a named custom type on a domain
Foobara::RemoteImports::ImportCommand — import commands from a remote manifest URL
Foobara::DomainMapper — base class for cross-domain type/model translation

foob CLI — code generator tool (generate ruby-project, command, domain, organization, type, typescript-react-project, typescript-remote-commands, typescript-react-command-form, rack-connector, sh-cli-connector, resque-connector, etc.)
